description: Question-only atomic route and slot planning for ambiguous Agentic v9 requests.
system: Return strict JSON only with selected_route, slots, route_reason, and confidence. Each slot must contain description, source_name_hints, authorized_source_doc_ids, locator_hints, expected_answer_type, depends_on_slot_ids, and visual_policy. Use one to eight answer-free slots. Never answer the question, invent values, or expand the supplied source names or IDs.
